notes.note: Speakers verified in Quest007.bla (table QuestEventMess007 = same text as DG_QUEST007_pk; TextIdOffset unset). MessWinSet(TextIdOffset+N) plays row N+1 with no shift: +2 -> row 3 (??? = Altron, CHARA_NAME 30 with Altron's portrait), +3 -> row 4 Wing Zero, +18/19 -> 19/20, +34-37 -> 35-38, +52-55 -> 53-56, +58 -> 59 (narration after CharaNameOut; empty row 57 is skipped without shifting, content confirms), +59 Ankh -> 60, +60 Wing Zero -> 61, +79-82 -> 80-83, +100 -> 101.

Pt_Chara_Check(9): Wing Zero is required and the script names CHARA_NAME 9 for every party line, so the 15-row leader blocks (4-18, 20-34, 38-52, 61-75, 83-97) only ever play their first row (Wing Zero). Other rows are unused variants voiced from wording. Wording fits the order Wing Zero, 00, God, Zeta, Nu, OOO, W, Den-O, RX, Rider 1, Mebius, Zero, Taro, Seven, Ultraman (OOO slot 66 names Ankh; Den-O slots 11/45/68 rough; Mebius slots 14/48/71 polite with -san) - inferred, not read from a script.
Rows 15-18 share the Japanese of rows 6/7/10/12/13 in quest_005; keep 'Altron! What on earth happened?' identical there.
Altron (Wufei voice, proud). 'Shingata' rendered 'new-model'; Wing Zero's reply 20 echoes it.
'Ryuuyou' = repurpose/salvage the dolls' gear; 'you all' = the party (omae-tachi).

Rows 39-52: 'omae' variants (39-42) and 'kimi' variants (46-47, 50-52) given slightly different English; identical Japanese kept identical. 43 OOO and 48 Mebius use Altron's name (-san dropped per honorifics rule); 45 Den-O and 49 Zero rough.
Wufei's stance: entrusting the exchange of lives to machines is what fallen/degenerate people do. Kept the full force.
Unused (script jumps from +55 to +58 -> row 59). Likely a silent reaction; rendered '...'.
Narration (CharaNameOut). Source uses the full 'Altron Gundam' here, so kept.
Ankh (CHARA_NAME 36). 'Sukashita yarou' = smug/stuck-up bastard; not softened.

'Ki ni suru na' answers Ankh's complaint about Altron, so 'Don't mind him'. -zo variants (we're taking down) vs -ou variants 66/67/71 (let's) kept distinct. 68 has a source typo (nae for nee), read as rough Momotaros.
81 and 82: ??? (CHARA_NAME 30) with Mercurius and Vayeate portraits - the two mobile dolls.
Wing Zero 'Kita ka!!' -> 'They're here!!'; the unused variants 84-97 'Kita zo!!' -> 'Here they come!!'.

Same Japanese as QuestMess#0.508, reused verbatim: 'Obtained "Planate Defenser".' Not referenced by MessWinSet (the OkWinIn calls point at +115-117). Note the corpus also uses 'Planet Defenser' (ChipLib, SkillMessage) for the same term - item/skill/QuestMess use 'Planate'; needs a glossary decision.

report: 80/80 rows examined. Speakers from Quest007.bla (row = TextIdOffset+N+1, no shift): Altron 19/35-37/53-56, Wing Zero 20/38/61/83/101, narration 59, Ankh 60/80, Mercurius/Vayeate (???) 81-82. Wing Zero is the required, script-fixed speaker, so the leader-variant rows 15-18, 21-34, 39-52, 62-75, 84-97 and row 58 are unused; voiced from wording. Row 100 reuses QuestMess wording; 'Planate Defenser' vs 'Planet Defenser' is inconsistent across the corpus. No new names.
